settings.label: Revision history
settings.title: Revision history — {{site}}
settings.noSite: Open this panel from within a site.
settings.usingDefaults: This site has no settings of its own and is using the module defaults.
settings.configured: This site has its own settings.
settings.captureEnabled: Capture a snapshot when a revisioned page is published
settings.maxSnapshots: Snapshots kept per page and language
settings.credentialResolved: A credential resolved for this account, so restricted pages can be captured.
settings.credentialMissing: No credential resolved. Capture stays anonymous, and pages the public cannot read will report NOT_PUBLIC. The secret is set in a file on the server, never here.
settings.credentialInherited: This site has no account of its own, so capture uses the module-wide account "{{account}}". Snapshots may contain whatever it can read.
settings.baseUrl: Address the server fetches its own pages from
settings.baseUrlHint: Use a loopback address, not the public hostname. Capture is a request the server makes to itself, and the public hostname goes through SEO rewriting that answers 404 for the markdown view. Leave empty to use the module default.
settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved
settings.saveShortcut: Press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) to save
